  34. Aug 25, 2026OfficialReserve/Injured

    Bud Clark

    Clark broke his ankle in the August 23 preseason game. Mike Macdonald said he would be out multiple months; the club placed him on injured reserve.

    Source: Seattle Seahawks ↗
  35. Aug 25, 2026OfficialReserve/Injured

    Mason Richman

    Richman suffered what the club described as a serious injury in the August 23 preseason game and was placed on injured reserve. No diagnosis is listed here because the cited announcement did not provide one.

    Source: Seattle Seahawks ↗
  36. Aug 22, 2026OfficialReserve/Injured

    Jake Bobo

    Bobo suffered a knee injury in the August 21 joint practice. The club placed him on injured reserve and said he will miss the 2026 season.

    Source: Seattle Seahawks ↗
  37. Aug 11, 2026OfficialReserve/Injured

    Robbie Ouzts

    Ouzts was placed on injured reserve after being sidelined in camp. Mike Macdonald had not disclosed the nature of the current injury in the cited announcement.

    Source: Seattle Seahawks ↗
